maria: putting up a new mock for the trace viewer toolbar — trying to simplify the top row actions. TL;DR: move Export into overflow and make Correlation ID copy more prominent. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/trace-toolbar-v3.png eli: thanks — looks cleaner. quick q: do we lose discoverability if export is hidden in overflow? :thinking: noah: from infra side export is called rarely but important for SEs. we can keep a tiny label icon next to overflow so people notice it's there. adele: accessibility note — if Export is in overflow, ensure it’s reachable via keyboard and that the overflow button has aria-expanded + aria-controls. also export action needs polite announcement when started. maria: good point. also thinking about putting a small copy icon right next to the correlation id so you can copy with one click. currently it’s buried in the drilldown header. eli: copy icon next to ID feels right. maybe show full id on hover, shortened by default (e.g., abc...xyz) to reduce clutter. copy should be accessible via `Cmd/Ctrl+C` when focused too. noah: implementable — we can render the id as a button with `role="button"` and `tabindex=0`. the copy action will call clipboard API. need fallback for older browsers. adele: prefer using native `
``` adele: small tweak: move `aria-live` to the announcer div only, keep button without aria-live. button should fire JS that writes to announcer div text. avoids double announcements. maria: noted. ok next steps: noah to update prototype + code, adele to add a11y checklist, eli to update microcopy list for i18n. i'll push a follow-up mock with share primary + overflow icon and the copy button visible. :sparkles: eli: thanks! adding to sprint board — #trace-ux. ux-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled Fri 10am PT — please bring prototypes.
